question: A shopkeeper purchased 70 kg of onions for Rs. 560 and sold the whole lot at the rate of Rs. 10 per kg. What will be his gain percentage?
solution:
**Given:**

Purchased quantity of onions = 70 kg

Cost price (CP) = Rs. 560

Selling price (SP) per kg = Rs. 10

**Formula Used:**

Gain Percentage = (Gain / Cost Price) × 100

Gain = Total Selling Price - Cost Price
